findings.title: spaces between Chinese and Latin/digit/placeholder runs
findings.note: zh-CN.md (Punctuation & typography): 'No space inserted between Chinese text and Latin/digit runs'. 55 of 172 values pad them (e.g. «你还没有 Team 套餐», «第 {step} 步», «# 条未读»), against 154 of 9,729 shipped zh-CN values; the exact shipped twins are unpadded («登录Radient», «移除{name}», «#条回复», «#张图片»). Spaces between two Latin words («Team Bridge», «5 MiB») and around the « · » separator stay. Suggested values remove only those spaces; for the 3 keys also in M1b-zh-CN, apply both.

findings.title: thread/reaction terms differ from Team Bridge
findings.note: The community home sits on the Team Bridge page, whose shipped strings say 讨论串 for thread (ui.teamBridge.replies.title/action/close/placeholder, 14 uses) and 表情回应 for reaction (ui.teamBridge.reactions.add, 15 uses). This file introduces 话题 (4) and 回应 (2), so the same control has two names depending on which org is selected.

Mechanical checks at aeecfe4a: key set and order equal English (172); every value parses with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and has the same argument names/types as English; plural arms present for the locale's CLDR categories; U+2026 ellipsis, never ASCII '...'; no bidi control characters; product names (Radient, Radient Console, Team Bridge, Local Operator Community) and #general byte-intact. All 71 suggested values were parsed the same way. Rendered fit and RTL layout not verified (no browser tool in this lane).

Accepted after reading all 172 values: 你 register, verb-forward phrasing, 智能体 for agent, 审核 for moderation, 版主 for the moderator badge, 准则 for guidelines; full-width punctuation in prose; plural arms are other-only with natural classifiers (条/张/个/名).
